name: E. DR Congo

when: Washington and Doha deals signed mid-2025; conflict decades old

current: UN peacekeepers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have stepped up civilian protection measures in Ituri province following renewed heavy fighting between Congolese forces and rebel groups. Active combat near health facilities has forced the evacuation of World Health Organization staff and Ebola responders, severely disrupting containment efforts for an outbreak that has now surpassed 12,000 cases. Separately, Kinshasa and Nairobi have taken steps to ease regional friction, with DR Congo and Kenya agreeing to restore full diplomatic ties and deepen economic cooperation.

escalation.note: Sustained heavy fighting in Ituri continues to disrupt Ebola containment efforts and force worker evacuations.

Azerbaijan had launched a campaign in September 2023, forcing the separatist Armenian authorities to capitulate after one day of hostilities.
